P.name: Dirty Fighting
P.title: Template:Data Akshan/Dirty Fighting
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Dirty Fighting|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Akshan
|skill        = I
|blurbicon    = Dirty Fighting.png
|icon         = Dirty Fighting.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Akshan''' uses a {{tip|basic attack}}, he fires an additional shot after a delay that deals {{as|50% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}, increased to {{as|100% AD}} against {{tip|minions}}. Issuing an {{tt|attack order|Default right-click/MB2}} on a different target before the additional shot has been launched causes '''Akshan''' to fire it at the new target. If the second shot is cancelled instead, he gains {{as|{{pplevel|20 to 75}}|ms}} {{times}} {{as|(1 + 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 1 second.
|description2 = The additional shot applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
|description3 = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Akshan's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability}} hits apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Dirty Fighting'' to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal them {{as|{{pp|15;40;80;150|1;6;11;16}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}; if the target is a {{tip|champion}}, '''Akshan''' will also gain a {{pplevel|40+(240/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} {{as|(+ 35% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds. The shield may be gained only once every few seconds.
|customlabel  = {{tt|Static Cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste, starts upon the shield being destroyed or expiring}}
|custominfo   = {{pp|16 to 4 for 4|1;6;11;16}}
|speed        = {{dv|{{tt|{{ccd|Akshan|missile_speed}}|Basic attack missile speed}}|{{tt|5000|Additional shot missile speed}}}}
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical Magic
|spellshield  = false
|spelleffects = special
|projectile   = true
|parry        = true
|notes        = 
* If the first shot has killed its target, '''Akshan''' will automatically acquire another enemy within 200 units beyond his {{sti|range|basic attack range}}, else he can do so by issuing an {{tt|attack order|Default right-click/MB2}} to a different target.
* Applies {{tip|basic damage}} for the second shot and {{tip|proc damage}} for the bonus damage.
* The second shot:
** Is treated as a basic attack.
** {{sti|critical strike|Critically strikes}} independently from the first shot.
** Can be cancelled by inputting a different command right after using the first shot.
** Counts as a separate hit for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}}, {{iis|Muramana}} {{nie|Shock}}, and {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}}.
** Starts the attack windup's cooldown after it is used, rather than when the first shot is.
* The attack speed scaling on the movement speed buff includes the bonus attack speed gained from '''Akshan's''' innate attack speed growth.
** At level 20, at minimum it grants {{fd|{{#expr: (20+(75-20)/17*(20-1)) * (1 + ({{ccd|Akshan|as_lvl}}*(20-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(20-1)))*0.01) round 2}}}} decaying movement speed.
* Changing targets for the second shot will also {{tip|acquisition range|acquire}} the new target. 
* The second shot, if the first shot's target was killed, will prioritize {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions, then {{tip|minion|minions}} on {{sti|health|{{as|low health}}}}.
* This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Akshan}} {{tip|basic attack}} causes him to fire a second attack that deals {{as|'''reduced''' physical damage}}. If '''Akshan''' cancels the second attack, he gains a brief burst of {{sti|{{as|move speed}}}}, increased based on his {{sti|{{as|attack speed}}}}.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Akshan's''' attacks and {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} to enemies hit. The third stack consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}; if the target was a {{tip|champion}}, he also gains a brief {{tip|shield}}.
}}

W.name: Going Rogue
W.title: Template:Data Akshan/Going Rogue
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Going Rogue|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Akshan |skill = W |blurbicon = Going Rogue.png |icon = Going Rogue 2.png |icon3 = Going Rogue.png |description = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Akshan''' marks enemy {{tip|champions}} that kill allied champions as ''Scoundrels'' for 60 seconds. If '''Akshan''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against a ''Scoundrel'' while alive and within 3 seconds of damaging them, he receives an additional {{g|100}} and resurrects all {{tip|death|dead}} allied champions that they have slain after 1 second. |description2 = When '''Akshan''' claims a ''Scoundrel's'' bounty he removes the marks of all other enemies. ''Scoundrels'' refresh their mark duration on subsequent kills, and will have their mark removed when they die by any means. '''Akshan''' cannot mark enemies as ''Scoundrels'' while they are dead. Allies are resurrected at their [[Spawn|summoning platform]]. |description3 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' enters {{tip|camouflage}}, which lasts indefinitely while he is near [[terrain]] or inside {{tip|brush}}, and for 2 seconds otherwise. During this time, he can see trails leading toward ''Scoundrels'', and while facing them if they are within {{tt|5000|Pending for test}} units, he gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' mana regeneration}}}} equal to {{as|12% of his '''missing''' mana}} as well as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. |leveling3 = {{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|80 to 120}}}} |description4 = ''Going Rogue'' can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after its duration. Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Going Rogue'' immediately. |description5 = '''''Akshan''' can move during Going Rogue's cast time.'' |description6 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akshan''' ends ''Going Rogue''. |cooldown = {{ap|18 to 2}} |cdstart = post-effect |cost = {{ap|40 to 0}} |costtype = Mana |customlabel = Detection Radius |custominfo = 800 |cast time = {{fd|0.5}} |targeting = Auto |affects = Self, Enemies |notes = * The mark displays the duration and slay count. ** Enemy champions that kill '''Akshan''' will not be marked as ''Scoundrels'' nor increase their slay count. * {{tip|Clone|Clones}} do not count for triggering ''Going Rogue's'' passive. * ''Going Rogue's'' buff refreshes to last indefinitely upon moving near terrain or into brush, and will refresh to 2 seconds after leaving near terrain or brush. * Allied champions within a {{tip|zombie state}} are resurrected only after the state ends. * '''Akshan''' can still trigger ''Going Rogue's'' passive while he is within a {{tip|zombie state}}. * Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup. |flavorsound = {{sm2|Akshan_Original_W_2.ogg}} ''"To the shadows... where the scoundrels hide."''
{{sm2|Akshan_Original_SFX_WRevive_buffcast_0.ogg}} ''Ally resurrection alert.'' |blurb = {{sbc|Passive:}} Enemy {{tip|champions}} that kill allied champions are marked as a ''Scoundrel'' for a long time. When {{ci|Akshan}} scores a {{tip|takedown}} on a ''Scoundrel'', he gains {{g|'''bonus''' gold}}, all allies killed by the ''Scoundrel'' are resurrected, and ''Scoundrel'' status is removed from all other enemies. |blurb2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' briefly gains {{tip|camouflage}}, or indefinitely while near [[terrain]] and in {{tip|brush}}. During this time, he can see trails leading toward ''Scoundrels'' and gains {{sti|{{as|move speed}}}} and {{sti|{{as|mana regeneration}}}} while moving toward them. |blurb3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akshan''' ends ''Going Rogue''. }}

R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Comeuppance|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Akshan
|skill        = R
|icon         = Comeuppance.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' locks onto the target enemy champion and begins {{tip|channel|channeling}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them as well as {{tip|sight|revealing}} himself. He gradually stores bullets into his weapon over the duration.
|leveling     = {{st|Maximum Bullets Stored|{{ap|5 to 7}}}}
{{st|Bullet Storing Interval Time|{{ap|2.5/4 to 2.5/6|round=4}} seconds}}
|description2 = ''Comeuppance'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically afterwards. ''Comeuppance'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|5-second}} cooldown if the channel is cancelled.
|description3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akshan''' fires all stored bullets at the target, each briefly granting {{tip|sight}} around their trajectory and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 30|critScaling=true}}, as well as by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 200 for 11|0 to 100|formula=2% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 100% '''missing''' health}}|health}}. The shots can hit {{tip|structures}}.
|leveling3    = <!--
-->{{st|Minimum Physical Damage per Bullet|{{ap|25 to 45}} {{as|(+ 15% AD)}}<!--
